current_candidate.representation: auto-generated cubic Hermite logit(Se) over log10(-h), with C derived from the same interpolant and floor-scaled log(K) interpolation on shared adaptive support

key_learnings: Independent approximation of theta and C can preserve endpoint state yet change Newton convergence; theta and C must remain derivative-consistent.
The original 23-30 point F-AHL09 representation was fast but K accuracy was insufficient in several wet/dry extremes.
Exact K closes fidelity but loses end-to-end speed.
Pure global log(K) tightening becomes pathological in the extreme dry tail because the authoritative floating-point K expression becomes numerically rough.
A floor-scaled K metric tied to B110_HCON_VSMALL avoids irrelevant dry-tail over-refinement.
At conductivity metric 3e-4 the shared-support candidate closes all tested fidelity cases and retains broad complete-Richards speed benefit.
superseded_or_rejected_routes: derivative-consistent retention plus analytical K as speed route
